node.title: Why am I losing accuracy?
node.author: Anonymous Monk
node.doctext:
Trying to use bignum (obviously), which I have never used before. I thought that once I had a variable as a extra precision number, it would stay that way. It seems I need to specify something else, but exactly what remains elusive to me.

#!/usr/bin/perl -w use strict; use bignum; use Digest::SHA qw(sha256_hex); my $i = 1; my $digest = hex(sha256_hex($i)); # just for debugging print "$digest\n"; $digest /= 64; print "$digest\n"; 48635463943209834798109814161294753926839975257569795305637098542720658922315 759929124112653668720465846270230530106900000000000000000000000000000000000 I expected to see: 48635463943209834798109814161294753926839975257569795305637098542720658922315 759929124112653668720465846270230530106874613399528051650579664730010295661
